status: Input and execution clarifications for the synthetic prototype; no historical results
opening_reference_validation: Reject an input whose first eligible opening reference is not within the09:30 minute. Even a09:30 timestamp only identifies the first supplied eligible trade; it does not certify full feed coverage. Historical import must reconcile that reference to preserved opening records and audit missing data.
event_identity: Preserve both timestamp and supplied row/event index. Equal timestamps do not authorize reordering or merging distinct price events.
deadline_priority: At09:45 the explicit deadline flatten takes priority. Records at/after09:45 do not trigger new entries or bracket exits, and the supplied mark is not used to infer earlier crossings. Missing required mark means an incomplete replay.
research_only: The deadline mark and trade-price fills are explicit simulation assumptions. No actual order, executable quote, queue position or historical profitability is verified.
